uncited: The method relies on the decomposition of the 3D volume into a set of 2D planar slices.
These slices are treated as geometric primitives (typically triangles or quads) that are rasterized by the GPU.
**Slice Generation**: The volume is intersected by a series of parallel planes.
**Rasterization and Shading**: The polygons are rasterized.
**Classification and Blending**: The scalar value is mapped to color and opacity via a transfer function.

**Comparison**: Compared to Ray-of-Regular-Reflection (R-RR) slicing: R-RR fails to capture the upper part of reflected appearance when the R-RR is apart from the volume because LPALs face away from the reflection point.
**Definition**: Rendering occurs only inside the selected geometric object's volume.
If Fire Lights are enabled, only those inside the cutter are rendered.
**Parameters**: Invert Cutter (invgizmo): When enabled, rendering occurs only outside the render cutter.
Rays not intersecting the cutter are shaded as well.
